system.description:
You’ve peered into the black abyss of magic and made it your life’s purpose to tear it apart, bit by bit. Every spell is a puzzle, every incantation a thread to unravel, and you weave your magic like a scientist cutting open the corpse of some celestial horror. You’ve devoured countless tomes, wrestled with the cryptic whispers of ancient, forgotten gods, and still, the secrets elude you. Some of you drown yourselves in a single school of magic, while others tread the wider path, tasting the edges of every arcane truth and knowing you’ll never grasp them all.

Class feature: Tome keeper
You carry a spellbook. During Downtime, you can scribe a spell from any spell list into it, copying it from a scroll, another spellbook or a teacher; you learn that spell without needing a spell tome, and the source is not consumed. You do not suffer Bane for casting a spell written in your spellbook, even if it is not on your spell list. Lose the book, and you keep the spells but lose this benefit until you scribe a new one.

Class power: Unravel 🟒1 ◈◈
